procedural_matters: GBR 8758 was represented by Grace Stockdale.
NED 3469 was represented by Eva Anink.
Lars van Dartel attended the hearing as a interpreter for NED 3469.
David Anink attended the hearing as a witness for NED 3469.
facts: RS Feva race 7 the wind was 8kn with small waves.
NED 3469 and GBR 8578 approached the starboard gate mark on port tack.
GBR 8578 was inside overlapped to NED 3469.
Another boat was outside overlapped of NED 3469 passed the mark in a distance of half a boat width.
NED 3469 and GBR 8578 touched the mark and then passed the mark on the wrong side.
NED 3469 and GBR 8578 took a one turn penalty.
There was no contact or injury.
conclusions: NED 3469 outside overlapped failed to give GBR 8578 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(1).
Since NED 3469 was compelled to break RRS 18.2(a) and RRS 31 as a consequence of an unidentified boat breaking RRS 18.2(a)(1), she is exonerated under RRS 43.1(a) for this breach.
Since GBR 8578 was compelled to break RRS 31 as a consequence of an unidentified boat breaking RRS 18.2(a)(1), she is exonerated under RRS 43.1(a) for this breach.
